name: new-order-order-theme-sync
title: Sync new order modal with Order Management UI
description: Replace the customer/sage visual override in the manager new-order modal with the existing Order Management cream, brown and gold operational design system.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The modal now uses the same cream, brown, gold, border, focus and primary-action treatment as OrderManagement.scss. Header and menu cards were made denser, controls now match the 42px/12px order toolbar rhythm, and the cart panel follows the same brown operational accent. Responsive and reduced-motion states remain. No order data or workflow code changed. The Ant Design popupClassName warning is separate from this style-only patch and remains to be migrated in NewOrderModal.jsx. Component tests, build and browser screenshots were not run because the connector environment has no executable repository checkout.
